# Everything about the “Tunnel of Love” event (Nuka World on Tour)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_85_nukaknights-post-event-tunneloflove.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This event is one of the 4 public events that will be released free of charge as an update for Fallout 76 with the Nuka World on Tour update on December 6th, 2022.

## Process

After public events appear on the map, you can travel there directly. The “Tunnel of Love” takes place in an old mine directly in “Nuka World on Tour”.

![](/uploads/20221014152222-1.jpg)

When you arrive at the mine, you will find the entrance to the “Tunnel of Love” and a ticket counter on the right. The robot Mr. Lovely is waiting there. You have to talk to him to start the event. As soon as the door opens, it starts.

![](/uploads/20221014004214-1.jpg)

Now the first task begins: **Find and place 6 heart lamps**. These are heart-shaped lamps, which you can see in the picture at the entrance, which are not hanging on the hooks like here, but are lying on the floor. You collect these and hang them back on empty hooks on the side of the rails.

Once this task is completed, you will need to **repair 10 rails**. The broken rails are up, just go there and fix them.

Meanwhile you will be attacked by pit hewers and mole rats.

Now the robot "Mr Lovely" wants to celebrate a wedding and you help him find parts with which you can assemble the robot lady "Miss Lovely": **Find 3 parts and build Miss Lovely"**. After you have found suitable robot parts, you bring them to the front of this stage. There "Miss Lovely" can be assembled.

![](/uploads/20221014004307-1.jpg)

![](/uploads/20221014152619-1.jpg)

Now the next task is: **Go to the wedding**.

Once the wedding is underway: **Eat, drink and emote to enjoy the wedding! (20)**

Now the event is over and you will receive your rewards.

## Rewards

- 5000 Nuka Cade points
- 1 of these weapons
 - Burning Love / Burning Love (bow)
 - The Killers
 - +50% VATS hit chance
 - +50 damage resistance when aiming
 - Tender Hand / Love Tap (45 MP)
 - Of the vampire
 - 25% higher rate of fire
 - Breaks 50% slower
- Burning Love / Burning Love (bow)
- 1 of these plans (tradable)
 - Blueprint: Armor Korki Shield
 - Blueprint: Tunnel of Love Snow Globe
 - Blueprint: Tunnel of Love Poster
- 2 of these recipes
 - BrahminBurgers
 - Caramel Mutfruit
 - CarnivalPie
 - GulperStuffedFood
 -NukaDog
 - RadroachSkewer2
 - RadscorpionKebab
 - RadscorpionSkewer
 -YaoGuaiPastry
- 1 of these plans (tradable) *Also available in other Nuka World events.* - Blueprint: Tabletop Nuka Launcher
 - Blueprint: Backpack Skin (Flaschi) (Trailer) **(not tradable)**
 - Blueprint: Backpack Skin (Korki) (Follower) **(not tradeable)**
 - Blueprint: Superhammer paint job (Korki-Klopper)
 - Blueprint: Nuka-Cade poster
 - Construction plan: Nuka-Cola advertising barrier (picture below in gallery)
 - Construction plan: Nuka-Cola crate stands
 - Construction plan: Nuka-Cola balloons (picture below in gallery)
 - Construction plan: Nuka-Cola bottle kiosk
 - Blueprint: Flaschi and Korki painting statue
 - Blueprint: Flaschi and Korki balloon statue
 - Blueprint: Flaschi and Korki tire jump statue
 - Blueprint: Flaschi and Korki running ball statue
 - Construction plan: Flaschi-Bot (picture below in gallery)

## Conclusion

This event can also be done quickly and is a change from the other events. The .45 submachine gun is actually quite usable with the Vampire prefix, but unfortunately the bow is less so. Thematically, the event naturally also fits into an amusement park. I also like the location with the Ultrazit crystals.

What do you think of this new event?
